Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Intern position at the European Labour Authority. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and web management, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your team and grow my skills in a European context.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites for clients. I have also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am comfortable with tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, and I am eager to apply my analytical and creative skills to support your digital marketing initiatives.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch. I am quick to learn new tools and platforms, and I am enthusiastic about contributing to the EURES mission.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Intern position at the European Labour Authority. With a strong foundation in SEO, content creation, and web management, I am eager to contribute to your digital marketing efforts and support the EURES mission of connecting jobseekers and employers across Europe.

Currently, as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and the Astra theme, ensuring they are user-friendly and optimized for search engines. My work involves tracking performance with tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console, which has given me a solid understanding of data-driven decision-making.

Beyond my professional experience, I have developed mirook.com, a project where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project has honed my skills in technical SEO and GEO, and I am passionate about staying ahead of emerging trends in digital marketing.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch. I am a quick learner, adaptable, and enthusiastic about collaborating with a diverse team. I am particularly drawn to the European Labour Authority's work in promoting fair labor mobility, and I would be thrilled to contribute to your digital marketing initiatives.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
